items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Jerome Richardson in the context of a recording listing, but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond or provide any personal anecdote or confirmation of a relationship.

ctx.x: It's listed here as George Holt and Bernie
Privin on trumpets, Jerome Richardson on clarinet, baritone, Al Klink and John Hafer on, it's listed as tenor sax, but I hear on the record a lot of flute and piccolo. Which I'm sure they play also.
